extDescription.message: Keeps your bookmarks identical in Chrome, Brave, Edge and Firefox, with backups in your own Google Drive.
extDescription.description: Store listing summary; Chrome Web Store allows at most 132 characters.

popupIntro.message: Link your Google account to keep bookmarks identical in every browser where Marksync is installed.

privacyNote.message: Bookmarks are stored only in a Marksync folder in your own Google Drive. Marksync cannot see any other file there.

syncOff.message: Sync is off in this browser

syncOffHint.message: Sync is turned off for this browser in Settings.

skippedItems_one.message: {1} item not supported in this browser

skippedItems_other.message: {1} items not supported in this browser

massDeleteRemote.message: {1} of {2} bookmarks were deleted in another browser or directly in Google Drive. Sync is paused until you decide. A backup is taken before anything is deleted here.

massDeleteLocal.message: {1} of {2} bookmarks were removed in this browser. Sync is paused so they are not deleted everywhere by mistake.

errNetwork.message: Google Drive could not be reached. Marksync will try again.

badgePaused.message: sync is paused, open it to decide

welcomeConnect.message: To start, connect your Google account below. Do the same in every browser where you install Marksync, with the same Google account.

welcomeNoDuplicates.message: Bookmarks that are already in several browsers are matched, not duplicated.

deviceNameHelp.message: Shown in backups and in the import list of your other browsers. Leave it empty to use the detected name.

syncIntervalLabel.message: Check for changes from other browsers every

syncHelp.message: Changes made in this browser are sent within about a second. Changes from your other browsers arrive as soon as you switch to this browser, and otherwise at the interval above.

restoreHelp.message: Restoring replaces the bookmarks in every connected browser. The current bookmarks are backed up first, so you can undo a restore.

backupReasonBeforeRemoteDelete.message: before a large deletion from another browser

confirmRestore.message: Replace the bookmarks in all browsers with the backup from {1}?

confirmDeleteBackup.message: Delete this backup from Google Drive?

confirmDisconnect.message:
Stop syncing this browser? Your bookmarks, your Drive files and your other connected browsers stay as they are.

To remove Marksync's access to your Google account in every browser, visit myaccount.google.com/permissions.

importIntro.message: Bring bookmarks from another browser into this one. When sync is on, they then appear in all your browsers.

importModeMerge.message: Merge into my bookmarks and skip the ones I already have

importModeFolder.message: Put them in a new folder

browsersEmpty.message: No other browsers yet. Install Marksync there and connect the same Google account. This works even if sync is turned off in that browser.

browsersOffline.message: Connect your Google account to see your other browsers.

importFileHelp.message: For browsers without Marksync. Export the file there first:

importFileChromium.message: Chrome, Brave, Edge: Bookmark manager → ⋮ → Export bookmarks.

importFileFirefox.message: Firefox: Bookmarks → Manage bookmarks → Import and Backup → Export Bookmarks to HTML.

importFailed_one.message: 1 could not be added in this browser.

importFailed_other.message: {1} could not be added in this browser.

removeBrowserHint.message: Remove a browser you no longer use from this list

confirmRemoveBrowser.message: Remove {1} from this list? Its bookmarks are not touched.

importedFolder.description: Name of the folder an import creates. {1}: source browser or file name, {2}: date.

deviceLabel.description: {1} is the browser name, {2} the operating system, e.g. "Brave on Windows".

errReconnect.message: Reconnect your Google account to keep syncing.

errNoClientId.message: This build has no Google OAuth client ID (WXT_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID). See docs/GOOGLE_SETUP.md.

errSignInState.message: Google sign-in returned an unexpected state.

errDriveNotGranted.message: Google Drive access was not granted. Connect again and allow Drive access.

errOtherAccount.message: Google returned a different account ({1}). Reconnect to continue.

errNewerSyncFile.message: The sync file in Google Drive was written by a newer Marksync. Update the extension.

errNotBackup.message: This file is not a Marksync backup.

errNotSnapshot.message: This file is not a Marksync browser snapshot.

errNoAnswer.message: The background script did not answer.
